summary:
## Standing operator rules
Never edit tests/conftest.py without posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-tests and waiting for @mira to approve it.

Never edit api/openapi.yaml without first posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-api and tagging @dana-api.

Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

## Current objective
Fix refund double-counting in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`. Run `legacy-s3-decommission` between other work, completing all nine steps in order, one at a time. The tenacity retry-loop refactor is paused until next sprint.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Buckets: `old-media-17`, `archive-25`; inventory: `final-inventory`; hosted zone: `Z1234567890ABC`; record: `legacy.acme.example`. Invoice contract: `items`, `total`, `limit`, `offset`; defaults 20/0. Sandbox payments: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is superseded and shut down. Legacy session factories: `ledgerly/db.py`, `ledgerly/repositories.py`, `tests/conftest.py`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Invalid-limit test expecting `items` was replaced with HTTP 422 and `limit` validation assertions. Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours is ruled out; it hid stuck jobs for hours.

## Recent work
Fixed PDF credit-line rendering, locale grouping, and pagination; focused tests passed, and billing completed `83 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed in 6.41s`. Decommission steps 1–6 are complete, including suspending versioning and deleting `photos/2017/logo.png` version `v-9f2c1a` from `old-media-17`. Next useful work is visual PDF comparison, then reconciliation.
